settings.label: Games Folder
settings.description:
The folder of MAME's ROM sets (a zip each, BIOS sets beside them)
[DEFAULT] Games/Arcade in Local Files' default folder: on the OSD/OS image, on the card's OSD-OS partition

settings.label: Screen
settings.description:
How the games are listed, from the next time Arcade opens
[ORIGINAL] OSD/OS's own tree, by players, decade and maker
[ARCADE] A cabinet's selection screen: the games on an arc, their picture, high scores and details, ◄ ► through the filters, COIN and START

settings.label: Start Filter
settings.description:
The list the Arcade screen opens on: All Games, Favorites, Recently Played, a genre, a number of players or a decade
One with no games opens on All Games

settings.label: Play at Startup
settings.description:
One of your favorite games, started as OSD/OS starts, as a game's options set it too
[NONE] No game starts with OSD/OS
There is one for the whole of OSD/OS: choosing a game replaces another module's

settings.label: Hint Bar
settings.description:
The key hints at the foot of the Arcade screen
[OFF] No bar: the list takes a game more, the column more of the high scores

settings.label: Help Line
settings.description:
The game's full name, as MAME has it, and what it is (its system, maker, year and players) under the Arcade screen's list
[OFF] No line: the list takes a game more, the column more of the high scores

settings.label: Start Info Screen
settings.description:
Before a game, how to come back to OSD/OS (and from the Arcade screen, the credits going in)
[OFF] The game starts straight from the list

settings.label: High Scores
settings.description:
Keep each game's high score table, as MAME's hiscore plugin does
For the games that forget it when they are switched off

settings.label: Online High Scores
settings.description:
High score tables from the internet beside this machine's own
Comes in a later version

settings.label: Online Play
settings.description:
Playing a game with someone over the internet
Comes in a later version

settings.label: Video
settings.description:
How MAME draws the game
[AUTO] As MAME's own settings say
Try another when a game shows no picture

settings.label: Read the Games Again
settings.description: Ask MAME about every game in the folder again
